description: Small curated smoke corpus; labels are not an independent human evaluation or a production quality guarantee.

memories.text: Use uv to install Python dependencies and manage virtual environments.
Run Python unit tests using pytest before submitting a change.
Every outbound HTTP request must have an explicit timeout.
Retry idempotent HTTP requests with exponential backoff and jitter.
Do not automatically retry a payment POST without an idempotency key.
Keep API credentials out of source code and application logs.
Verify TLS certificates for all external HTTPS connections.
The memory database runs locally in SQLite; it does not require a cloud service.
Create a database backup before a destructive schema change.
Project-specific preferences override global defaults only within that project.
Ask for clarification when two applicable user preferences contradict each other.
Move blocking file and database operations off the asynchronous event loop.
Release resources in a finally block when an asynchronous task is cancelled.
Validate external inputs with Pydantic models at the application boundary.
Retain source references when merging duplicate observations.
Process maintenance work in bounded batches so foreground requests can proceed.
Refresh expired evidence before using it to make a decision.
When required information is missing, research it or ask the user before acting.
Pin the embedding model revision so stored vectors remain comparable.
Superseded memories remain available for explicit historical recall.
